checks.title: the frame: region named by the heading, the row of three steps with aria-current on the first, «Шаг 1 из 3», one primary «Далее», no Back on the first step
checks.covers: settings.heading, settings.progress auto row, accessibility.role region, the footer

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#three'); const root = w.querySelector('.sf-wizard'); return root.getAttribute('role') === 'region' && root.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Новый сайт' && w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-position').textContent.trim() === 'Шаг 1 из 3' && w.querySelector('sf-steps [aria-current="step"]')?.dataset.stepIndex === '0' && w.querySelectorAll('.sf-wizard-primary').length === 1 && w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-primary').textContent.includes('Далее') && !w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-back') && w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-title').textContent.trim() === 'Название'; })()

checks.title: Next with an empty required field: invalid, the field shows its message and takes focus, the step stays

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#three'); const field = w.querySelector('sf-input[name="title"]'); return field.hasAttribute('invalid') && w.current !== 'template' && document.activeElement === field.querySelector('input'); })()

checks.title: filled, Next moves on: submit then change, the step reads done, the title has focus, the status says where
checks.covers: events.submit, events.change, values.current, focus to the title

steps.script: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('#three sf-input[name="title"] input'); input.value = 'Мой магазин'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#three'); return w.getAttribute('current') === 'template' && w.querySelector('sf-wizard-step[name="name"]').getAttribute('state') === 'done' && document.activeElement === w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-title') && w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-announce').textContent.includes('Шаг 2 из 3') && w.value.name.title === 'Мой магазин'; })()

checks.title: Back shows the previous step and keeps its answer

steps.script: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('#three sf-input[name="title"] input'); input.value = 'Мой магазин'; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return true; })()

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#three'); return w.getAttribute('current') === 'name' && w.querySelector('sf-input[name="title"] input').value === 'Мой магазин'; })()

checks.title: place pages: the primary is a submit button of the step's form with name wizard-action and its word; Back is a link to the previous step

steps.check: (() => { const w = document.querySelector('#pages'); const form = w.querySelector('sf-wizard-step[name="protection"] form'); const button = w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-primary button'); return Boolean(form.id) && button.type === 'submit' && button.getAttribute('form') === form.id && button.name === 'wizard-action' && button.value === 'run' && button.form === form && button.textContent.includes('Выпустить сертификат') && w.querySelector('.sf-wizard-back a')?.getAttribute('href') === '?step=notify'; })()

checks.title: go-to-step shows a step without change; refused for a missing one
